objective.name: wrapper.touch
objective.description: Mutate wrapper-backed matter and emit matter event notifications

#root.role: Trigger a wrapper-local mutation that flows back through the Matter event contract.

effects.wrapper_state: The wrapper-local backing state is mutated.
effects.@matter: The wrapper-backed matter may be updated and may emit notifications.

transformation_contract.morphing: A wrapper touch request becomes a mutated wrapper-backed matter state and an explicit success acknowledgement.
invariants: wrapper.touch must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: wrapper.touch returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: wrapper.touch fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
